---
title: Measure catalog
---

This catalog documents the implemented ACS definitions, source variables,
year-specific calculation rules, coverage, and geography conventions.

Download the [YAML catalog](measures.yml),
[tract metadata](hh_acs_measures.metadata.json), or
[ZCTA metadata](hh_acs_measures_zcta.metadata.json).
For a particular data release, use the metadata attached to that
[GitHub release](https://github.com/geomarker-io/hh_acs_measures/releases).
